header: InterCode Spider dev 官方预检通过的 1015 题；公开测试集反馈后的开发修订 v3，不是整库或独立未见测试
changes: Replace prescriptive eight-step plan with <=3 semantic checks and <=100 words (prompt instruction, not postselection).
Both arms use identical independent SQL derivation policy instead of ambiguous follow-plan staff contract.
Both arms increase API output cap from 512 to 4096; preserve actual usage and finish reason.
question: Does a short frozen semantic review add value under the revised, matched executor interface?
primaryMetric: paired official reward sum difference over all 1015 locked cases
selectionRule: One registered candidate. Synthetic development checks first. One valid official receipt per ID per arm; infrastructure errors only may resume. Preserve every version and score regardless of sign. No repeated target-score selection until winning.
targetExposure: Revision motivated by already observed v2 aggregate results and synthetic canary defect; adaptive public-benchmark development, not independent confirmation.
launchCondition: No other benchmark worker; existing SQL container only; disk >=6 GiB; development checks passed; model resources safe. Do not alter active tau runtime.
